founders.name: Haji Inam Ellahi Asar (Late)
body: Born in October 1927 in Chiniot, he devoted more than five decades of his life to the service of humanity, earning deep respect as a distinguished social worker and philanthropist.

As the Founder and Honorary Project Director of Hijaz Hospital, he transformed his lifelong commitment to compassion and public welfare into a lasting institution dedicated to healthcare and human service.
founders.editorialNote: Source: “Picture passport sized - Haji Inam Ellahi Asar (Late)” · “Link his name to the following content on a separate page” — links to the P26 profile template (profile-design-system.html). Name spelling varies between sources: “Ellahi” (Leadership.txt) vs “Elahi” (Profiles.txt) — confirm canonical spelling.

founders.name: Mian Abdul Waheed (Late)
body: Born in April 1931 in East Punjab, he was a distinguished humanitarian admired for his integrity, humility, and lifelong dedication to public welfare and community service.

As a founding member and one of the principal driving forces behind the establishment of Hijaz Hospital, alongside Haji Inam Elahi Asar, he played a pivotal role in shaping the institution's mission of compassionate healthcare and social service.
